teaser: A spirit level, forgotten on a windowsill, is as good a place as any to start. You are a 4, the builder, and an ISFP, the artist who feels before explaining. The crossing is specific: a number that wants walls plumb and true meets a type that wants the walls to feel like something, not just stand there. You lay brick in color, measuring twice and still asking whether the shade is right. Most readings of the 4 forget the hand that paints the foundation after it is poured; this one doesn't.
